description: Start item generation and return its job ID. This is the draft path, not topic autopilot. No dry-run mode exists; accepted work consumes allowance. Poll get_job without repeating this call. Optional body.kit_mode: auto (default; organization settings decide whether a low-confidence content kit is held) or hold_for_review (always hold the kit so it can be read and edited before the write; needs the v2 article pipeline, else 409 article_pipeline_not_v2 before any charge). A held run stops at awaiting_review with kit_status needs_review.

anyOf.description:
Whether the published article body shows source citations.

``STRUCTURED_ONLY`` (default) strips inline links to clean prose; the used
sources are still captured as metadata. ``INLINE`` keeps the links and
appends a ``## Sources`` section.
anyOf.title: CitationMode

anyOf.description:
How an article body shows its sources.

``bottom_only`` keeps prose free of links and appends a numbered sources
list; ``inline_only`` keeps inline links and appends no list.
anyOf.title: CitationStyle

anyOf.description: Optional writing-direction knobs for item generation (all optional).
anyOf.title: PublicDirection

anyOf.description: How the v2 approval gate treats the kit of one generation.
anyOf.title: KitMode

anyOf.description: Recovery behavior; source verification is always mandatory.
anyOf.title: SourceVerificationFailureMode

idempotency_key.description: Stable operation key. Reuse for the same request after a dropped response; use a new key for a new intended operation.
